svg.title: Schema → shared document → editor
svg.desc: One contract; distinct representations. Explanatory schematic. 1 · Application schema: content: flow → paragraph: text · allowed marks: bold Rules supplied to clients and server; not access permissions. 2 · Edit against the current model: Example: insert text at [0, 2]. Paths describe the current view. Schema shapes and rules guide compilation and normalization. 3 · Stable token state and operations: Token identities survive changing model paths. The server checks each whole change before acceptance. 4 · Schema-shaped model → binding → editor: The model is projected from token state, not a second replicated tree. Native rendering and supported nodes remain application responsibilities.
